## #1 — tg_jp — 2007-01-17
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/1240/post-7853>

Radium Exporter.js

Hello

I post export script for radium renderer. you can make radium scene file (.scn) from Cheetah3D.

about radium renderer -> http://www.radiumrenderer.com/

script download -> http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=20

please try it. 

old version had bug of exporting wrong normals, if you have tried old one, please download latest version again.

tg_jp, Hiroto.

Links: http://www.radiumrenderer.com/, http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=20
